```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Core
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

# Bayesian modelling
library(brms)
library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)

options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr")

# -----------------------------
# Project paths + constants
# -----------------------------
DATA_DIR <- "//Users/dana/Documents/ABDA/ABDA-git"   # adjust once
DIR_2024  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "2024")

PR_KW <- 2300                       # rated power [kW]
P_MIN_KW <- 10                      # minimum power threshold [kW]
WS_MIN <- 4                         # wind speed lower bound [m/s]
WS_MAX <- 13.5                      # wind speed upper bound [m/s]
PNORM_MIN <- 0.05                   # normalized power lower bound
PNORM_MAX <- 0.95                   # normalized power upper bound
FULL_OPER_S <- 600                  # full 10-min interval
BIN_WIDTH <- 0.5                    # used for slope diagnostics

# Helper: consistent timestamp parsing
parse_ts_utc <- function(x) as.POSIXct(x, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
```


````{r}
# Metadata
turbine_metadata <- read.csv(file.path(DIR_2024, "Hill_of_Towie_turbine_metadata.csv")) %>%
  mutate(`Station.ID` = as.character(`Station.ID`)) %>%
  select(TurbineName = Turbine.Name, StationId = Station.ID)

# SCADA tables (April 2024)
SCTurbine <- read.csv(file.path(DIR_2024, "tblSCTurbine_2024_04.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    TimeStamp = parse_ts_utc(TimeStamp),
    StationId = as.character(StationId)
  )

SCTurGrid <- read.csv(file.path(DIR_2024, "tblSCTurGrid_2024_04.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    TimeStamp = parse_ts_utc(TimeStamp),
    StationId = as.character(StationId)
  ) %>%
  select(TimeStamp, StationId, ActivePower = wtc_ActPower_mean)

SCTurFlag <- read.csv(file.path(DIR_2024, "tblSCTurFlag_2024_04.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    TimeStamp = parse_ts_utc(TimeStamp),
    StationId = as.character(StationId)
  )

GridScientific <- read.csv(file.path(DIR_2024, "tblGridScientific_2024_04.csv"))
# Select the turbine-level variables you actually use downstream
TD_raw <- SCTurbine %>%
  transmute(
    TimeStamp,
    StationId,
    AcWindSp   = wtc_AcWindSp_mean,
    WindDir    = wtc_ActualWindDirection_mean,
    NacelPos   = wtc_NacelPos_mean,
    PitchA     = wtc_PitcPosA_mean,
    PitchB     = wtc_PitcPosB_mean,
    PitchC     = wtc_PitcPosC_mean
  ) %>%
  left_join(SCTurGrid, by = c("TimeStamp", "StationId")) %>%
  left_join(SCTurFlag, by = c("TimeStamp", "StationId")) %>%
  # try to map whatever flag column represents operational time on
  rename(TimeInOper = wtc_ScInOper_timeon) %>%
  left_join(turbine_metadata, by = "StationId") %>%
  arrange(TurbineName, TimeStamp)

# Quick checks
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(TD_raw[, c("StationId", "TimeStamp")]))
summary(is.na(TD_raw$ActivePower))
length(unique(TD_raw$TurbineName))
TD_raw <- TD_raw %>%
  mutate(
    PitchMax = pmax(PitchA, PitchB, PitchC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pnorm    = ActivePower / PR_KW
  )

# Keep only "valid-ish" producing points (basic QC)
TD_basic <- TD_raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(TurbineName),
    !is.na(ActivePower),
    ActivePower > P_MIN_KW,
    AcWindSp > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(TurbineName) %>%
  mutate(t_index = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
# Estimate pitch stop threshold from full-operation records
pitch_stop_95 <- TD_raw %>%
  filter(TimeInOper == FULL_OPER_S, !is.na(PitchMax)) %>%
  summarise(th = quantile(PitchMax, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(th)

pitch_stop_95

TD_clean <- TD_raw %>%
  mutate(
    PitchMax = pmax(PitchA, PitchB, PitchC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pnorm    = ActivePower / PR_KW,
    flag_pitch_stop = PitchMax > pitch_stop_95
  ) %>%
  filter(
    TimeInOper == FULL_OPER_S,
    !flag_pitch_stop,
    Pnorm > PNORM_MIN, Pnorm < PNORM_MAX,
    AcWindSp > WS_MIN, AcWindSp < WS_MAX,
    !is.na(TurbineName),
    !is.na(AcWindSp),
    !is.na(Pnorm)
  ) %>%
  group_by(StationId) %>%
  mutate(t_min = as.numeric(difftime(TimeStamp, min(TimeStamp), units = "mins"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(logP = log(Pnorm)) %>%
  arrange(StationId, t_min)

dim(TD_clean)
summary(TD_clean$Pnorm)


````

````{r}

ggplot(TD_clean, aes(x = TimeStamp, y = Pnorm, group = TurbineName, color = TurbineName)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Pnorm", title = "Cleaned normalized power time series (all turbines)")
plot(
  TD_clean$AcWindSp, TD_clean$logP,
  pch = 16, cex = 0.4,
  xlab = "Wind speed (m/s)",
  ylab = "log(Pnorm)",
  main = "Wind speed vs log(Pnorm)"
)
````

````{r}
TD_clean_T1 <- TD_clean %>% filter(TurbineName == "T01")

priors_single <- c(
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0.05, 0.05), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.1), class = "sigma")
)

fit_single <- brm(
  Pnorm ~ AcWindSp,
  data = TD_clean_T1,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors_single,
  chains = 2, iter = 2000, cores = 2,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
````



````{r}
priors_ar1 <- c(
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0.05, 0.05), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "ar")   # phi, shrunk toward 0
)

fit_ar_single <- brm(
  Pnorm ~ AcWindSp + ar(time = t_min, p = 1),
  data = TD_clean_T1,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors_ar1,
  chains = 2, iter = 2000, cores = 2,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)

````

````{r}
priors_gam <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sds"),   # spline smoothness
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.2), class = "sigma")
)

fit_k_single <- brm(
  Pnorm ~ s(AcWindSp, k = 10),
  data = TD_clean_T1,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors_gam,
  chains = 2, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, cores = 2,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12)
)
````


````{r}

priors_gam_ar1 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sds"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "ar"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.2), class = "sigma")
)

fit_k_ar_single <- brm(
  Pnorm ~ s(AcWindSp, k = 10) + ar(time = t_min, p = 1),
  data = TD_clean_T1,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors_gam_ar1,
  chains = 2, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, cores = 2,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12)
)

````



````{r}

TD_clean_0 <- TD_clean %>%
  filter(
    StationId != "2304530",
    t_min >= 200,
    t_min <= 2500
  )


priors_hier_gam_ar1 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sds"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "ar"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.2), class = "sd"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.2), class = "sigma")
)

priors_gam_ar1_gr <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sds"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "ar"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.2), class = "sigma")
)


````

```{r}
fit_k <- brm(
  Pnorm ~ s(AcWindSp, k = 10) +
          ar(time = t_min, gr = StationId, p = 1) +
          (1 | StationId),
  data = TD_clean_0,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors_hier_gam_ar1,
  chains = 2, cores = 2, iter = 1000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
```
````{r}
fit_gam_ar1_gr <- brm(
  Pnorm ~ s(AcWindSp, k = 10) +
          ar(time = t_min, gr = StationId, p = 1),
  data = TD_clean_0,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors_gam_ar1_gr,
  chains = 2, cores = 2, iter = 1000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
````


````{r}

res_k <- residuals(fit_k, summary = TRUE)[, "Estimate"]

acf(res_k, main = "ACF of residuals (AR(1) model)")
cor(res_k[-1], res_k[-length(res_k)], use = "complete.obs")

````

````{r}
summary(fit_k)
mcmc_plot(fit_k, type = "trace")
pp_check(fit_k)
````

````{r}

posterior_summary_table <- function(fit_k, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)) {
  posterior::summarise_draws(
    posterior::as_draws_array(fit_k),
    "mean", "sd", "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail",
    q05 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[1]),
    q50 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[2]),
    q95 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[3])
  )
}

sum_fit_k  <- posterior_summary_table(fit_k)
# sum_fit_t2 <- posterior_summary_table(fit_t2)

sum_fit_k
````

````{r}

# ---- folders ----
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("results/figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("results/tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("results/models", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Give the model a name (useful if you have many)
MODEL_NAME <- "fit_k"

# ---- 1) Save model object ----
saveRDS(fit_k, file = file.path("results/models", paste0(MODEL_NAME, ".rds")))

# ---- 2) Residual ACF plot ----
res_k <- residuals(fit_k, summary = TRUE)[, "Estimate"]


png(file.path("results/figures", paste0(MODEL_NAME, "_acf.png")),
    width = 1400, height = 900, res = 150)
acf(res_k, main = "ACF of residuals (Hierarchical nonlinear GAM + AR(1) model")
dev.off()

# # Also save lag-1 residual correlation to a text file
# lag1_cor <- cor(res_k[-1], res_k[-length(res_k)], use = "complete.obs")
# writeLines(paste("Lag-1 residual correlation:", lag1_cor),
#            con = file.path("results", paste0(MODEL_NAME, "_residual_cor.txt")))

# ---- 3) MCMC trace plots ----
# mcmc_plot returns a ggplot, so save with ggsave
library(ggplot2)

p_trace <- mcmc_plot(fit_k, type = "trace")
ggsave(filename = file.path("results/figures", paste0(MODEL_NAME, "_trace.png")),
       plot = p_trace, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 150)

# ---- 4) Posterior predictive check ----
p_pp <- pp_check(fit_k)
ggsave(filename = file.path("results/figures", paste0(MODEL_NAME, "_ppcheck.png")),
       plot = p_pp, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 150)

# ---- 5) Smooth term plot (for GAM) ----
p_smooth <- plot(conditional_smooths(fit_k), ask = FALSE)[[1]]
ggsave(filename = file.path("results/figures", paste0(MODEL_NAME, "_smooth.png")),
       plot = p_smooth, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 150)

# ---- 6) Posterior summary table (dataframe) ----
library(posterior)

posterior_summary_table <- function(fit_k, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)) {
  posterior::summarise_draws(
    posterior::as_draws_array(fit_k),
    "mean", "sd", "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail",
    q05 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[1]),
    q50 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[2]),
    q95 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[3])
  )
}

sum_fit_k <- posterior_summary_table(fit_k)

# Save as CSV (easy + robust)
write.csv(sum_fit_k,
          file = file.path("results/tables", paste0(MODEL_NAME, "_posterior_summary.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Optional: save as LaTeX table using knitr + kableExtra
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

sum_fit_k_small <- sum_fit_k %>%
  filter(grepl("^b_|^ar\\[|^sigma$|^sds_|^sd_", variable)) %>%
  select(variable, mean, sd,rhat) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

# create LaTeX table
tex <- knitr::kable(
  sum_fit_k_small,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption = "Posterior summary for the hierarchical GAM + AR(1) model with turbine-level random effects.",
  label = "tab:fit_k_main"
)

dir.create("results/tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(tex, "results/tables/fit_k_main.tex")

````

````{r}
write.csv(sum_fit_k_single,
          file = file.path("results/tables",
                           paste0(MODEL_NAME, "_posterior_summary.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

# ---- compact table for report ----
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

sum_fit_k_single_small <- sum_fit_k_single %>%
  filter(grepl("^b_|^sigma$|^sds_", variable)) %>%  # no AR, no random effects
  select(variable, mean, sd, rhat) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

tex <- knitr::kable(
  sum_fit_k_single_small,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption = "Posterior summary for the nonlinear GAM model (single turbine).",
  label = "tab:fit_k_single_main"
)

writeLines(tex,
           file.path("results/tables",
                     paste0(MODEL_NAME, "_main.tex")))
````

````{r}
# Give the model a name

library(posterior)

posterior_summary_table <- function(fit, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)) {
  posterior::summarise_draws(
    posterior::as_draws_array(fit),
    "mean", "sd", "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail",
    q05 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[1]),
    q50 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[2]),
    q95 = ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs[3])
  )
}
````
